Columns of the v1 concordance, in order

Source: R/split.R
v1_columns.Rd

v1_columns are the columns of the v1 file. concordance_columns are the columns of the current concordance in the v1 layout: since fix 24, versions is schema_versions (XSD and observed versions), earliest_version and pct_filers_reporting are added and duplicated is dropped (see xpath_version_fields()).

Usage

v1_columns

concordance_columns

Format

An object of class character of length 23.

An object of class character of length 24.
